title: Data Analyst
text:
Data Analyst - Example Analytics Pvt Ltd, Pune (Hybrid)

About the role
Example Analytics Pvt Ltd helps retail brands understand their stores. You will join a team of six analysts and work with category managers every week.

What you will do
- Write SQL queries to pull sales and inventory data from our warehouse
- Build weekly reports in Excel for category managers
- Automate data pulls with Python scripts
- Use statistics to explain changes in weekly sales
- Publish dashboards in Power BI for regional heads
- Schedule data pipelines with Apache Airflow

What we need
- 1 to 3 years of experience as an analyst
- Strong SQL and Excel
- Working knowledge of Python
- Experience with Alteryx workflows

Good to have
- Tableau
- Git for version control
- Exposure to SAS

Notice period: 30 days or less. CTC as per industry standards.
